title: JSON protocol drops item hints in both directions
summary: indigo_libs/indigo_json.c writes the property-level "hints" of every def*Vector but no item-level hints, and its parser reads no hints at all, while indigo_xml.c writes and parses hints on both properties and items (indigo_xml.c hints_attribute(), defSwitch line 2136) and indigo_docs/PROTOCOLS.md line 80 says every item may carry hints. JSON clients such as the web control panel therefore never receive item hints: warn_on_set on AGENT_SCHEDULER_TASK_COMMAND RESET_ALL and DELETE_ALL, SERVER RESTART ('Restart INDIGO Server?'), SERVER INSTALL items, MOUNT_ALIGNMENT_RESET and the Astroasis factory resets. Next: add item "hints" to the JSON writer for all vector types and to the JSON parser, a JSON round-trip unit test, and a server acceptance check that the scheduler hints arrive over the network. Owner chose on 2026-11-14 to record this only.
evidence: Source read on 2026-11-14 at 2ed5675dd: indigo_json.c lines 823-836 (defSwitchVector items without hints) and no hints handling in the parser; indigo_xml.c lines 2116 and 2136 emit item hints (verification.md of the task).
